title: EB-I20R batch-safe energy-ledger independent qualification
technical_finding: Prepared-handle generation is ledger-local but not ledger-unique. After prepare_trial clears trial lineage from the ledger, abort_prepared validates only prepared_active, handle readiness and generation equality. Two ledger instances can therefore both own generation 1 and a foreign prepared handle can consume the wrong ledger's prepared state.
invariant_impact: Invariant 7 transactional time steps: foreign candidate metadata can mutate another transaction's prepared state.
Invariant 16 MultiSWAP primary use case: per-column/worker isolation is not guaranteed for prepared energy handles.
Invariant 29 no silent dependencies: correctness currently depends on callers never mixing handles across ledger instances.
hard_nonclaims: F-VQ80 does not canonically admit EB-I20R.
A successful verifier workflow means the attack and classification executed successfully; it is not a positive qualification result.
No energy physics or conservation algebra is disproven by this finding; the blocker is transactional provenance/isolation.
No production or reference source is modified by F-VQ80.
next_owner: minimal owner remediation adding ledger-instance-bound prepared-handle provenance, followed by fresh independent qualification
